verdict.rationale: Poke's release notes document that users can share images of existing data, such as spreadsheets, so Poke can extract and visualize them. That is first-party image-input support, but it is described only for data extraction feeding table and chart creation. missing for 10: documented general interpretation of screenshots and photos beyond spreadsheet data, evidence of accuracy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them

citations.quote: share images of existing data (like spreadsheets) for Poke to extract and visualize
